caption: Lux Project Settings define shared range limits and the values used by Reset to Project Defaults.
alt: Lux Project Settings showing limits and default headlamp values.
capture_instructions: Capture Edit → Project Settings → Plugins → Lux in Unreal. Expand Intensity, Attenuation Radius, Light Defaults and Advanced Defaults so their built-in fields and values are visible, using two cropped panels if necessary.

caption: Project defaults constrain supported numeric values and supply the reset targets for personal Lux preferences.
alt: Lux shared Project Settings and individual preferences data flow.
capture_instructions: Create an ownership diagram of ULuxProjectSettings (Config=Editor) feeding Intensity/Radius constraints and Reset to Project Defaults, while ULuxUserSettings keeps separate per-user selections.

caption: Reset restores Lux's personal headlamp adjustments without changing whether the headlamp is enabled.
alt: Lux Reset to Project Defaults command restoring edited properties.
capture_instructions: Record changing Intensity, Light Color and one Advanced property, then selecting Reset to Project Defaults from the native Lux menu. Reopen the menu to show the restored values and unchanged toolbar icon state.

caption: Reset copies the project defaults into personal preferences and refreshes the live temporary light if one exists.
alt: Lux reset data flow without altering session on/off state.
capture_instructions: Draw a flowchart from the Lux menu Reset command to ULuxProjectSettings, through supported clamps into ULuxUserSettings, and finally to ApplyLightSettings for an existing transient point light. Explicitly keep bEnabled outside the flow.

caption: Lux remembers personal light properties independently from the temporary on/off state.
alt: Lux enabled-state reset and persistent user intensity comparison.
capture_instructions: Create a two-panel before-and-after Unreal Editor capture: the first shows Lux enabled with customized intensity; after restarting, show the icon gray and the dropdown still holding the customized intensity.

caption: Project defaults, personal values, session activation and the transient component use separate storage lifetimes.
alt: Lux configuration and transient state persistence diagram.
capture_instructions: Make a four-lane storage diagram: Config=Editor project defaults, EditorPerProjectUserSettings personal properties, session-only bEnabled, and RF_Transient UPointLightComponent. Show which survive editor restart.
